summary:
Revised implementation plan incorporating:
- Saved Diary Read Mode: Tapping any saved entry opens in clean, distraction-free Read Mode with a top-right Pencil/Edit button to transition into the Editing Canvas. New diary entries launch directly into the Editing Canvas.
- Unified Media Canvas Layer: Images, animated GIFs (including Gboard GIFs), and stickers all share identical free-drag positioning and interactive corner resize/scaling handles.
- Native standard keyboard behavior, keyboard-level Gboard GIF integration, 100% pure diary app (no books), swipe actions with 16 export formats, 15 strict themes, PIN/Pattern/Biometrics security, and AES-256 hidden vault backups.
